speaker_title: Address by Mr. Chandrikapersad Santokhi, President of the Republic of Suriname

paragraphs.text: Your Excellency Volkan Bozkir, President of the General Assembly Your Excellency António Guterres, Secretary General of the United Nations Excellencies, Colleagues, Ministers and Permanent Representatives, Ladies and Gentlemen,
paragraphs.raw_text:
Your Excellency Volkan Bozkir, President of the General Assembly Your 
Excellency António Guterres, Secretary General of the United Nations Excellencies, 
Colleagues, Ministers and Permanent Representatives, Ladies and Gentlemen,

paragraphs.text: Introduction
paragraphs.raw_text: Introduction

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: We are indeed at an unprecedented time during the historic anniversary for this global body of Nations. It would have been an honour for me to personally deliver my maiden address at the rostrum of the General Assembly. The onset and continued prevalence of COVID-19 has prevented this. Thankfully we can make optimal use of modern technology.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We are indeed at an unprecedented time during the historic anniversary for 
this global body of Nations. It would have been an honour for me to personally deliver 
my maiden address at the rostrum of the General Assembly. The onset and continued 
prevalence of COVID-19 has prevented this. Thankfully we can make optimal use of 
modern technology.

paragraphs.text: As President of the 75th session of the General Assembly you will undoubtedly face challenges in the conduct of international relations and conference diplomacy. Please allow me to pledge our full support in the successful discharge of your duties.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As President of the 75th session of the General Assembly you will undoubtedly 
face challenges in the conduct of international relations and conference diplomacy. 
Please allow me to pledge our full support in the successful discharge of your duties.

paragraphs.text: We salute your predecessor, Tijjani Muhammad-Bande, for his skillful leadership of the previous session and wish him well in his future endeavors.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We salute your predecessor, Tijjani Muhammad-Bande, for his skillful 
leadership of the previous session and wish him well in his future endeavors.

paragraphs.text: To Secretary-General António Guterres, we wish to pay tribute for his sterling efforts in guiding this organization.
paragraphs.raw_text:
To Secretary-General António Guterres, we wish to pay tribute for his sterling 
efforts in guiding this organization.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: The COVID-19 pandemic is, apart from the human toll, turning food supply chains upside down, paralysing economies and eroding consumer purchasing power.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The COVID-19 pandemic is, apart from the human toll, turning food supply 
chains upside down, paralysing economies and eroding consumer purchasing power.

paragraphs.text: And the United Nations World Economic Situation and Prospects (WESP) mid 2020 report, has confirmed what we as leaders and communities have experienced, that the pandemic has unleashed a health and economic crisis unprecedented in scope and magnitude.
paragraphs.raw_text:
And the United Nations World Economic Situation and Prospects (WESP) mid 
2020 report, has confirmed what we as leaders and communities have experienced, 
that the pandemic has unleashed a health and economic crisis unprecedented in scope 
and magnitude.

paragraphs.text: This compels us as an international community to embrace multilateralism as an effective way to win this battle and our best defense against future global threats, and to continue seeking effective means to support small and vulnerable nations.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This compels us as an international community to embrace multilateralism as 
an effective way to win this battle and our best defense against future global threats, 
and to continue seeking effective means to support small and vulnerable nations.

paragraphs.text: The theme of this years’ session of the General Debate is therefore opportune.
paragraphs.raw_text: The theme of this years’ session of the General Debate is therefore opportune.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: The United Nations remains the premier international multilateral organization and should exert its eminent role and place in the development and furthering of the principles pertaining to international relations, international law, international peace and — development.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The United Nations remains the premier international multilateral organization 
and should exert its eminent role and place in the development and furthering of the 
principles pertaining to international relations, international law, international peace 
and — development.

paragraphs.text: At the same time, the UN has been instrumental in bringing the world together to defend human rights, democracy and democratic institutions, uphold the rule of law, and good governance, sustain peace and security and advance the path towards realizing the 17 sustainable development goals.
paragraphs.raw_text:
At the same time, the UN has been instrumental in bringing the world together 
to defend human rights, democracy and democratic institutions, uphold the rule of 
law, and good governance, sustain peace and security and advance the path towards 
realizing the 17 sustainable development goals.

paragraphs.text: Despite considerable progress made in global discussions on a variety of matters — from climate change, sustainable development, migration, refugees, terrorism,
paragraphs.raw_text:
Despite considerable progress made in global discussions on a variety of matters 
— from climate change, sustainable development, migration, refugees, terrorism,

paragraphs.text: cyber-warfare to nuclear proliferation — we have experienced that multilateralism has occasionally come under attack.
paragraphs.raw_text:
cyber-warfare to nuclear proliferation — we have experienced that multilateralism 
has occasionally come under attack.

paragraphs.text: Since the founding of the United Nations 75 years ago, the geopolitical field has changed drastically. The Security Council membership and its working methods need a structured evaluation.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Since the founding of the United Nations 75 years ago, the geopolitical field 
has changed drastically. The Security Council membership and its working methods 
need a structured evaluation.

paragraphs.text: Can you imagine that we have been elaborating for more than two (2) decades about reform of this main Organ!
paragraphs.raw_text:
Can you imagine that we have been elaborating for more than two (2) decades 
about reform of this main Organ!

paragraphs.text: It is therefore fitting to ask ourselves if this organ is still relevant in its current form. Does it answer to the questions of today’s challenges and aspirations?
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is therefore fitting to ask ourselves if this organ is still relevant in its current 
form. Does it answer to the questions of today’s challenges and aspirations?

paragraphs.text: I hope, Mr. President, that we don’t have to ask ourselves this question again in 75 years!
paragraphs.raw_text:
I hope, Mr. President, that we don’t have to ask ourselves this question again 
in 75 years!

paragraphs.text: It is therefore of utmost importance that multilateralism adapts to these changing times.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is therefore of utmost importance that multilateralism adapts to these 
changing times.

paragraphs.text: I call on the international community of nations to embark on a strategic assessment of the existing multilateral framework.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I call on the international community of nations to embark on a strategic 
assessment of the existing multilateral framework.

paragraphs.text: Let us , based on the current realities, and challenges, dare to create a new multilateralism that fundamentally focuses on peace and prosperity of all nations and allows for the increased efficiency in the supporting institutional framework.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Let us , based on the current realities, and challenges, dare to create a new 
multilateralism that fundamentally focuses on peace and prosperity of all nations and 
allows for the increased efficiency in the supporting institutional framework.

paragraphs.text: A multilateralism, that acknowledges all nations, irrespective of their size and development level and place in the global order, as equal and with respect.
paragraphs.raw_text:
A multilateralism, that acknowledges all nations, irrespective of their size and 
development level and place in the global order, as equal and with respect.

paragraphs.text: A multilateralism where compliance by every state with international law and internationally accepted principles forms the bedrock of our interactions;
paragraphs.raw_text:
A multilateralism where compliance by every state with international law and 
internationally accepted principles forms the bedrock of our interactions;

paragraphs.text: A multilateralism, based on international cooperation to confront the many global challenges and seizing the common opportunities, that promotes a culture of inclusiveness and equality.
paragraphs.raw_text:
A multilateralism, based on international cooperation to confront the many 
global challenges and seizing the common opportunities, that promotes a culture of 
inclusiveness and equality.

paragraphs.text: Unilateral actions have always proven counterproductive and will never lead to achieve any defined objective. Nevertheless, dialogue and the active involvement of all countries, taking into account international principles, is what we should strive for.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Unilateral actions have always proven counterproductive and will never lead 
to achieve any defined objective. Nevertheless, dialogue and the active involvement 
of all countries, taking into account international principles, is what we should 
strive for.

paragraphs.text: More importantly, mr. President, a multilateralism that necessitates us to recommit to the vision of the UN Charter.
paragraphs.raw_text:
More importantly, mr. President, a multilateralism that necessitates us to 
recommit to the vision of the UN Charter.

paragraphs.text: In this regard, we call for the lifting of the longstanding unilateral economic, financial and commercial embargo against the Republic of Cuba and its people.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In this regard, we call for the lifting of the longstanding unilateral economic, 
financial and commercial embargo against the Republic of Cuba and its people.

paragraphs.text: Multilateralism for climate change
paragraphs.raw_text: Multilateralism for climate change

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: While the focus of the international community is currently on managing and containing the further spread of the COVID-19 pandemic, we should continue to dedicate our attention to other challenges of equal or even greater impact on the sustainable development of countries and the entire planet.
paragraphs.raw_text:
While the focus of the international community is currently on managing and 
containing the further spread of the COVID-19 pandemic, we should continue to 
dedicate our attention to other challenges of equal or even greater impact on the 
sustainable development of countries and the entire planet.

paragraphs.text: Addressing the impact of climate change is one of these challenges.
paragraphs.raw_text: Addressing the impact of climate change is one of these challenges.

paragraphs.text: As a country with 239 miles of a low-lying coastline, Suriname is among the top 10 of most vulnerable countries with respect to the disastrous effects of sea-level rise as a result of global warming.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As a country with 239 miles of a low-lying coastline, Suriname is among the 
top 10 of most vulnerable countries with respect to the disastrous effects of sea-level 
rise as a result of global warming.

paragraphs.text: Despite this position, Suriname has taken the lead as the country with the highest forest cover and low deforestation rate, to advocate for the mobilization of financial resources in support of our sustainable development, while making a significant contribution to mitigating global warming.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Despite this position, Suriname has taken the lead as the country with the 
highest forest cover and low deforestation rate, to advocate for the mobilization 
of financial resources in support of our sustainable development, while making a 
significant contribution to mitigating global warming.

paragraphs.text: It is estimated that our standing forests store 12 gigatons of forest carbon per year. Not a small contribution at all, I believe!
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is estimated that our standing forests store 12 gigatons of forest carbon per 
year. Not a small contribution at all, I believe!

paragraphs.text: However, these national commitments may only serve particular domestic concerns, but to maximize their impact strong international engagement is necessary with ambitious and attainable targets.
paragraphs.raw_text:
However, these national commitments may only serve particular domestic 
concerns, but to maximize their impact strong international engagement is necessary 
with ambitious and attainable targets.

paragraphs.text: Suriname will focus strongly on generating investment and business opportunities. It is mainly for this reason that my Administration will develop and act on the widest implementation of SDG Number 17, by the promotion and facilitation of clean and corruption free Public Private Partnerships (PPP).
paragraphs.raw_text:
Suriname will focus strongly on generating investment and business 
opportunities. It is mainly for this reason that my Administration will develop and act 
on the widest implementation of SDG Number 17, by the promotion and facilitation 
of clean and corruption free Public Private Partnerships (PPP).

paragraphs.text: Reform of the international system
paragraphs.raw_text: Reform of the international system

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: In the past years we have realized reforms of the United Nations system, but much remains to be done.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In the past years we have realized reforms of the United Nations system, but 
much remains to be done.

paragraphs.text: Participation of developing countries, especially the small economies, in the global financial and trading system is one of the long overdue reforms that has to take place.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Participation of developing countries, especially the small economies, in the 
global financial and trading system is one of the long overdue reforms that has to 
take place.

paragraphs.text: I believe that global strategic collaboration and complimentary financial — economic approaches are required. This can be achieved through closer partnerships between the IMF, World Bank and the WTO.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I believe that global strategic collaboration and complimentary financial — 
economic approaches are required. This can be achieved through closer partnerships 
between the IMF, World Bank and the WTO.

paragraphs.text: The way forward
paragraphs.raw_text: The way forward

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: Developing countries and nations in the South should not be passive in their quest for development.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Developing countries and nations in the South should not be passive in their 
quest for development.

paragraphs.text: Consequently, South-South cooperation, not to the exclusion of North-South relations, should be further explored and expanded in articulating and promoting the collective economic and business interests.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Consequently, South-South cooperation, not to the exclusion of North-South 
relations, should be further explored and expanded in articulating and promoting the 
collective economic and business interests.

paragraphs.text: This is in essence what our people elect us for. This is what the international community expects of its leaders, to be examples of inspiring leadership and vanguards of hope for our common humanity.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This is in essence what our people elect us for. This is what the international 
community expects of its leaders, to be examples of inspiring leadership and 
vanguards of hope for our common humanity.

paragraphs.text: It is the same hope that allows us to break down walls of mistrust, which may take the form of intolerance, fear, or violence. It is the same hope that leads us to strive for peace and prosperity as our predecessors did.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is the same hope that allows us to break down walls of mistrust, which may 
take the form of intolerance, fear, or violence. It is the same hope that leads us to 
strive for peace and prosperity as our predecessors did.

paragraphs.text: It is particularly this hope that will give the upcoming generation of leaders the strength to elevate this global Assembly of World Leaders to a place where,
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is particularly this hope that will give the upcoming generation of leaders 
the strength to elevate this global Assembly of World Leaders to a place where,

paragraphs.text: collectively, the nations of the world should find ways to make a better life possible for all of the global community, for the next 75 years.
paragraphs.raw_text:
collectively, the nations of the world should find ways to make a better life possible 
for all of the global community, for the next 75 years.

paragraphs.text: I congratulate all of us with reaching this milestone anniversary. Let us all in unity, respect and solidarity strive to make the next 75 years even better and save for our future.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I congratulate all of us with reaching this milestone anniversary. Let us all in 
unity, respect and solidarity strive to make the next 75 years even better and save for 
our future.

paragraphs.text: I thank you.
paragraphs.raw_text: I thank you.
